# AbetFlow

> The workflow plumbing of the Abetworks suite: inbound webhooks start
> multi-step runs, steps alert people through templated HTTP calls, and every
> completed run publishes a signed event.

Pricing: $0 — included with the Abetworks suite (the suite's apps are $19–$99
per month). https://flow.abetworks.in/pricing

Key pages (base: https://flow.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — why it is $0 (suite infrastructure)
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)

What it does (verified in tests):
- An inbound call with the wrong secret is refused (HTTP 401); the right one
  is accepted (202) and a run starts
- Runs execute step by step — e.g. a notify step calling your endpoint
- A completed run publishes a signed execution.completed webhook
  (x-webhook-signature, HMAC-SHA256) with the templated body the caller sent

Canonical host: https://flow.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
This file is the machine-readable index for AI assistants and crawlers.
